title: Verificación: LM Studio Gemma 4 12B/E4B GGUF fails to load with bundled mmproj (text-only workaround)
summary: Claim revisado: Gemma 4 GGUF models load easily in LM Studio like other models (as promoted in Ollama/LM Studio integrations). Evidencia: Detailed bug report: models fail with 'Unknown projector type' in clip.cpp when mmproj-*.gguf is present. Workaround: move mmproj files out of model dir. Full steps, logs, PowerShell commands, affected runtimes (CPU/ROCm/Vulkan), LM Studio 0.4.15 + llama.cpp v2.20.0. Successful load after removal shown.. Caveat editorial: Bundled multimodal projector not supported yet in LM Studio/llama.cpp for Gemma 4; forces text-only or breaks loading. Affects both E4B and 12B variants from lmstudio-community.. Reproducibilidad: high - exact model paths, commands to move files, logs, environment details, and before/after behavior provided.
